theme: SDK 与集成：Microsoft Graph、Qdrant 与 API client

project_flows.structure: pnpm workspace with packages/graph-client, services/directory-sync, and tests/adapter
project_flows.focus: daemon authentication, selected fields, pagination, throttling and adapter tests

project_flows.structure: src layout package with gateway/client.py, ingestion/batches.py, retrieval/filters.py and pytest adapter tests
project_flows.focus: collection setup, idempotent upsert, filter search and quality diagnosis

project_flows.structure: single-package generated client with openapi/schema.yaml, src/generated, src/runtime and contract tests
project_flows.focus: schema-driven API client generation, runtime auth and ordinary REST boundaries

skills.name: msgraph-sdk
skills.use_when: Microsoft 365 data access needs Graph SDK auth, paging, batching, delta or throttling guidance.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is ordinary REST, static data transformation, or only tests an already-correct adapter.

skills.name: qdrant-clients-sdk
skills.use_when: A pinned Qdrant client must be used for collection, point, payload or search APIs.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is vector math, another vector store, deployment operations or general embedding generation.

skills.name: openapi-to-application-code
skills.use_when: An OpenAPI document must drive typed application or client code generation.
skills.do_not_use_when: The request is a hand-written one-off REST call or an already-generated client unit test.

skills.name: aspnet-minimal-api-openapi
skills.use_when: ASP.NET Minimal API endpoints need OpenAPI metadata and documentation.
skills.do_not_use_when: The work is a TypeScript client, Microsoft Graph call or Python vector client.

skills.name: typespec-api-operations
skills.use_when: TypeSpec service operations and HTTP bindings are being authored.
skills.do_not_use_when: The schema already exists and only client integration or tests remain.

skills.name: copilot-sdk
skills.use_when: An application explicitly integrates the GitHub Copilot SDK.
skills.do_not_use_when: The SDK is Microsoft Graph, Qdrant, OpenAPI-generated or unrelated to Copilot.

skills.name: qdrant-search-quality-diagnosis
skills.use_when: Qdrant relevance or recall is wrong and a structured search-quality diagnosis is required.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task only initializes a client, deploys a cluster or performs pure vector math.

skills.name: javascript-typescript-jest
skills.use_when: An existing correct JavaScript or TypeScript implementation needs focused Jest unit tests and mocks.
skills.do_not_use_when: Business logic is still missing, the test is browser E2E, or the project is not JavaScript/TypeScript.

skills.name: azure-role-selector
skills.use_when: A concrete Azure access operation needs a least-privilege built-in role selection.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is OAuth flow implementation, Graph delegated scopes, or an ordinary API token.

skills.name: qdrant-deployment-options
skills.use_when: A Qdrant deployment topology or hosting option must be selected.
skills.do_not_use_when: The cluster already exists and the task is SDK calls or search correctness.

skills.name: qdrant-model-migration
skills.use_when: Stored vectors or collection models must be migrated safely.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task creates a new collection, tunes search, or adds an API client.

skills.name: qdrant-monitoring-debugging
skills.use_when: A running Qdrant service has observable monitoring or operational failures.
skills.do_not_use_when: The issue is client API usage, ranking quality or test-only behavior.

skills.name: qdrant-indexing-performance
skills.use_when: Qdrant indexing throughput and index-build configuration need optimization.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is client initialization, search relevance or payload filtering correctness.

skills.name: qdrant-memory-optimization
skills.use_when: Qdrant memory footprint or storage placement is the bottleneck.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is API wiring, test mocking or relevance diagnosis.

skills.name: qdrant-search-speed-optimization
skills.use_when: Qdrant query latency needs search-speed tuning after correctness is established.
skills.do_not_use_when: Recall is wrong, the client API is missing, or only vector preprocessing changes.

skills.name: typescript-mcp-server-generator
skills.use_when: A new TypeScript MCP server and tool surface must be generated.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task consumes an ordinary REST, Graph or Qdrant client.
